mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE ancestor_ids (tenant_id, id, parent_lead_id, depth) AS ( SELECT lead_row.tenant_id, lead_row.id, lead_row.parent_lead_id, 0 FROM crm_lead lead_row WHERE lead_row.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND lead_row.id = #{leadId} AND lead_row.status <> 'DELETED' UNION ALL SELECT parent.tenant_id, parent.id, parent.parent_lead_id, child.depth + 1 FROM ancestor_ids child JOIN crm_lead parent ON parent.tenant_id = child.tenant_id AND parent.id = child.parent_lead_id AND parent.status <> 'DELETED' WHERE child.depth < #{depthLimit} ) SELECT id FROM ancestor_ids ORDER BY depth ASC

WITH RECURSIVE descendant_ids (tenant_id, id, depth) AS ( SELECT lead_row.tenant_id, lead_row.id, 0 FROM crm_lead lead_row WHERE lead_row.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND lead_row.id = #{leadId} AND lead_row.status <> 'DELETED' UNION ALL SELECT child.tenant_id, child.id, parent.depth + 1 FROM descendant_ids parent JOIN crm_lead child ON child.tenant_id = parent.tenant_id AND child.parent_lead_id = parent.id AND child.status <> 'DELETED' WHERE parent.depth < #{depthLimit} LIMIT #{nodeLimit} ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS node_count, COALESCE(MAX(depth), 0) AS height FROM descendant_ids

WITH RECURSIVE descendant_ids (tenant_id, id, depth) AS ( SELECT root.tenant_id, root.id, 0 FROM crm_lead root WHERE root.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND root.id = #{leadId} AND root.status <> 'DELETED' UNION ALL SELECT child.tenant_id, child.id, parent.depth + 1 FROM crm_lead child JOIN descendant_ids parent ON parent.tenant_id = child.tenant_id AND parent.id = child.parent_lead_id WHERE child.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND child.status <> 'DELETED' AND parent.depth < #{maxDepth} LIMIT #{traversalLimit} ) SELECT c.id FROM crm_lead c JOIN descendant_ids descendant ON descendant.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND descendant.id = c.id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CONVERTED') AND descendant.depth > 0
ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT #{resultLimit}

WITH RECURSIVE ancestor_ids (tenant_id, id, parent_lead_id, depth) AS ( SELECT parent.tenant_id, parent.id, parent.parent_lead_id, 1 FROM crm_lead child JOIN crm_lead parent ON parent.tenant_id = child.tenant_id AND parent.id = child.parent_lead_id AND parent.status <> 'DELETED' WHERE child.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND child.id = #{leadId} UNION ALL SELECT parent.tenant_id, parent.id, parent.parent_lead_id, ancestor.depth + 1 FROM ancestor_ids ancestor JOIN crm_lead parent ON parent.tenant_id = ancestor.tenant_id AND parent.id = ancestor.parent_lead_id AND parent.status <> 'DELETED' WHERE ancestor.depth < #{limit} ) SELECT c.id FROM crm_lead c JOIN ancestor_ids ancestor ON ancestor.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND ancestor.id = c.id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CONVERTED')
ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT MIN(tag.tag_name) AS tag_name FROM crm_lead_tag tag JOIN crm_lead c ON c.tenant_id = tag.tenant_id AND c.id = tag.lead_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CONVERTED')
GROUP BY tag.tag_key ORDER BY tag.tag_key ASC LIMIT #{limit}
